title: Live feature-disabled response is misclassified and required onboarding states are unreachable

sourceEvidence.observation: publicJson discards the structured FEATURE_DISABLED code and buildMcpClientGuide is called with coordinationFeatureEnabled hard-coded true.

diagnoseConnection receives only Team and Human IDs, so its network, discovery, unsupported-client, coordination-disabled, and MCP-unavailable branches are unreachable; buildMcpClientGuide receives no MCP readiness fact.
The shared state model contains coordination_feature_disabled and mcp_unavailable, but current callers do not supply the live facts needed to reach them truthfully.
The diagnostic function already has the required fail-closed branches; the defect is the missing live context at the call sites.

actions: Preserve and classify structured discovery errors such as FEATURE_DISABLED instead of collapsing every non-OK response into discovery_unavailable.
Remove the hard-coded coordinationFeatureEnabled=true and supply server-derived feature state.
Supply network, discovery, supported-client, coordination-feature, and MCP-readiness facts to diagnoseConnection and buildMcpClientGuide.
Add focused unit/component tests proving every required state is reachable and truthful before a fresh candidate Browser attempt.
